name: Wraithlight
description: An eight-solar-mass hole feeding steadily enough to glow in X-rays across the halo. One desert world endures the radiation while a scattered belt grinds in the far dark. The light here comes from death, not birth.

stars.name: Wraithlight Maw
stars.description: A black hole pulling a steady thread of gas from a shredded companion, bright in X-rays. The disk burns at ten million degrees while the center stays perfectly dark. State changes sweep through on weekly cycles.

planets.name: Penumbra
planets.description: A dune world lit by X-rays instead of sunshine, its deserts sterilized to the bedrock. Shielded warrens below host the observers who tend the monitors. Sunsets here are a radiation alarm, not a view.

belts.name: Wraith Scatter
belts.description: A scattered disk of icy bodies stirred by the hole's ancient formation kick. Orbits here tilt at wild angles from the old violence. Long-period comets fall inward from its edge.
